questions.q: Which is the best definition of fitness?
options: The ability to cope with the demands of the environment
Being able to run a long way
questions.why: Cambridge definition: the ability to cope with (or meet) the demands of the environment.

questions.q: Which is an example of social health and well-being?
questions.why: Friendship and support are part of social well-being.

questions.q: A person who smokes but plays football every week is best described as
questions.why: They can meet the demands of football but smoking harms health.

questions.q: Describe two benefits of regular exercise for mental health.
questions.model: Exercise reduces stress and anxiety because it releases feel-good chemicals, and it improves self-esteem by giving a sense of achievement.
